standard-dialogue.npc: Howdy there partner! Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?

steps.npc: That's right. There's a funny story behind them, their shipment was held up by thieves.
The crate was marked 'Dragon Plates'. Apparently they thought it was some kind of armour, when really it's just a plate with a dragon on it!

options.text: I'd like to check holiday items please!

steps.player: I'd like to check holiday items please!

steps.npc: Sure thing, let me just see what you're missing.

standard-dialogue-obtaining-banana-hat.npc: Howdy there partner! You came at just the right time! I've got something for ya!
Well, I did some rooting around in my house and found this really neat hat.

standard-dialogue-obtaining-banana-hat.player: A hat? What sort of hat...

standard-dialogue-obtaining-banana-hat.npc: A banana hat! Would you like it?

steps.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.npc: Looks like you've got no space for it, I'll hold onto it till you do. Just come to me to claim it.

steps.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.npc: So what else can I do for you partner? Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?

steps.player: No thanks, I don't want it right now.

steps.npc: No problem amigo, come back to me to claim it if you change your mind.

standard-dialogue-obtaining-mystic-cards.npc: Oh wow, you did it! Well done!
I was wondering when someone would complete this. I've been holding on to the reward for a while.
The being who gave it to me was... rather strange.
They didn't say. But they did give me some sage advice before they left.
I don't remember exactly. Something about making the most of your time...

standard-dialogue-obtaining-mystic-cards.player: I... don't worry. Thank you for the reward, see you around!
